## Why This Benchmark Is Included

Functional code generation is a recognized language-model task.

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Classroom value** | Demonstrates decoding, functional correctness, and sandboxed evaluation. |
| **Systems behavior** | Autoregressive generation with variable output length and isolated execution. |
| **Benchmark lineage** | Official Qwen model plus established execution-based EvalPlus evaluation. |
| **Model choice** | It is the smallest official Qwen2.5-Coder release. |
| **Dataset choice** | HumanEval+ strengthens the established HumanEval contract. |
| **Quality metric** | pass@1 measures functional correctness rather than text similarity. |
| **Published baseline** | Qwen2.5-Coder technical report Table 16 |
| **Alternative rejected** | Project-defined prompts and expected strings are not a code benchmark. |

## Authoritative Sources and Adaptation

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Authority** | Qwen and EvalPlus |
| **Model** | [open source](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct) |
| **Evaluator** | [open source](https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus) |

**Adaptation boundary:** The max runner preserves Qwen's prompt and stop rules, uses pinned Transformers for laptop inference, and evaluates generated code only in a locked-down container built from the pinned EvalPlus source.

## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload code-generation --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd.json provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload code-generation --profile max

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload code-generation --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload code-generation --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

| **Field** | **Value** |

| **Target** | 0.573 |
| **Direction** | higher |
| **Target kind** | published reference reproduction |
| **Target basis** | literature |
| **Tolerance** | 0.0 |
| **Reference runs** | 0 |

**Reviewer notes:**

- The target is the Qwen2.5-Coder technical report HumanEval+ pass@1 result.
- The pinned EvalPlus v0.1.10 reference self-check passes 163 of 164 canonical solutions; HumanEval/32 is the single known upstream exception and remains in the denominator for published-score comparability.
- The first authoritative max run on 2026-07-17 passed 91 of 164 tasks (0.554878), three tasks below the 94-pass gate; the target and tolerance remain unchanged.

## Results

Run the benchmark and read your own report:

```bash
uv run mlperf run --workload code-generation --profile max
```

Every run writes an HTML dashboard for reading, JSON for machine use, CSV for spreadsheets, and a `.provd.json` provenance manifest. Those artifacts carry the quality decision, timing distribution, hardware and software fingerprint, asset digests, and model lineage for the run you performed.

See [Reading Results](../../guide/results.qmd) for how to interpret them.

**Selection rationale:** Smallest official Qwen2.5-Coder instruction checkpoint with a published HumanEval+ result.

**Backend rationale:** The pinned Transformers checkpoint supports CPU, CUDA, and Apple MPS execution.
